messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (hosted + dedicated routing). Spike detected 2026-03-15T09:02Z. Datadog: https://dd.example/r/abc123. PagerDuty incident P12345 triggered.

samantha (oncall): acked — I'm on it. paging kai + omar. assigning PD to kai. @kai @omar can you join?

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident P12345 assigned to kai (oncall). Escalation policy: oncall-ops.

kai (infra): I see 503/502 surge, tracing shows requests hitting router -> routed to dedicated pool dedicated-usw-3 -> pool returns NO_BACKENDS. Router logs: `pool_match=0 pool_estimate=0 mark_unavailable`. But autoscaler metric shows desired=8, active=0. weird.

omar (runtime): pulling router logs and routing policy. Initial suspicion: router is using the wrong metric key (pool_capacity_estimate) fed by a stale autoscaler output. Also see fallback churn: requests bounce between us-west and eu-central with repeated variant-mismatch errors.

lee (cs): I'm notifying affected customers: acct-alpha, acct-beta, acct-gamma. prepping status note.

samantha (oncall): quick triage: is this an autoscaler bug or router misinterpretation? which one do we fix first to stop customer impact?

autoscaler-bot: Recent autoscaler run at 09:00Z reported desired=8 target, but health-checks failed; scaled down to min=0 due to `scale_policy: drain_on_health_failure=true`.

kai (infra): Confirmed: autoscaler set pool min_instances=0 because of a failing GPU health probe after a kernel update on some nodes. However router is subscribed to a different metric (pool_estimate) that got a stale 0 and the routing policy has fallback enabled. Router removed the pool from candidate set, then fallback policy sent traffic to eu-central, where model-variant compatibility fails, so router falls back again -> loop. Net result: traffic blackholed for ~12m.

omar (runtime): Here's a snippet from the routing config that allowed this behavior:
```
routing.fallback.enabled: true
routing.fallback.region_priority: ["us-west-2", "eu-central-1"]
routing.fallback.allow_variant_switch: true
routing.fallback.allowed_variants: ["model-v2-q4", "model-v2-q8"]
router.metric_key: "pool_capacity_estimate"  # DEPRECATED, can be stale
```

kai (infra): mitigation plan (live):
1) disable global fallback to stop region-churn: `rbctl routing update global-fallback --enabled=false`
2) override pool min to bring instances back: `rbctl pools set --id=dedicated-usw-3 --min-instances=4 --reason="emergency override"`
3) restart router worker(s) to force refetch of pool state: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/router-usw-2`
4) notify CS and PD.

samantha (oncall): doing step 1 now.

kai (infra): ran step 2. autoscaler-bot acknowledged: `override accepted, provisioning 4 instances in pool dedicated-usw-3 (expected ready in ~3m)`

autoscaler-bot: Provisioning logs: instance-78 started, instance-79 started, instance-80 started, instance-81 started. GPUs passed health checks.

omar (runtime): restarted router workers. router now reading `pool_active_instances` rather than stale estimate after restart. I see routing table re-include dedicated-usw-3. 5xxs dropping.

incidents-bot: UPDATE: Error rate back to baseline. 5xx spike lasted ~12 minutes (09:02Z - 09:14Z). Automatic alert cleared in Datadog.

lee (cs): Sent customer notification: brief outage, engineers mitigated, follow-up will include timeline.

samantha (oncall): summary for handoff -> kai:
- root cause: combination of (a) autoscaler draining pool on kernel-health failures, (b) router reading deprecated/stale metric `pool_capacity_estimate` and marking pool unavailable, (c) permissive fallback policy that allowed region/variant churn leading to loop.
- impact: ~12m of increased 5xx for hosted endpoints; 3 enterprise accounts reported errors; no data loss; SLA window exposed, CS alerted.
- mitigation applied: disabled global fallback, emergency set min_instances=4 for dedicated-usw-3, restarted router workers to refresh metrics.
- next steps: postmortem with follow-ups: (1) change router metric to authoritative `pool_active_instances` and fail closed (no fallback) on stale data, (2) tighten fallback policy to avoid cross-region variant-switching by default, (3) change autoscaler health-failure action from drain->quarantine to avoid immediate scale-to-zero, (4) run canary for kernel updates on GPUs.

kai (infra): taking ownership for post-incident follow-up and will coordinate the infra changes and a short maintenance window to test autoscaler/healthprobe behavior.

samantha (oncall): handing off. I'm clear to resume normal rotation. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

omar (runtime): quick note for postmortem: capture router log dump and the sequence numbers for the fallback decisions, include hashes of config that allowed variant switch. I'll attach traces to the PM.

lee (cs): I'll follow up with impacted customers with timeline + interim mitigations.

incidents-bot: Incident P12345 status: mitigated. Postmortem owner: kai. Timeline doc placeholder: https://docs.example/r/incidents/P12345-postmortem

samantha (oncall): closing channel; handoff complete.
